# mistershell_canary_service_override (Resource)

Manages only the enabled flag of an existing built-in Canary service. Destroy restores the enabled flag captured at create or import; it never deletes the built-in service. Requires MisterShell 2.1 or newer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_canary_service" "builtin" {
  id = var.builtin_canary_service_id
}

resource "mistershell_canary_service_override" "example" {
  service_id = tonumber(data.mistershell_canary_service.builtin.id)
  enabled    = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the built-in service is enabled.
- `service_id` (Number) Existing built-in service ID from the canary_service data source.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Built-in service ID; also the import identity.
- `original_enabled` (Boolean) Enabled flag captured at create or import, restored on destroy.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mistershell_canary_service_override.example 123
```
